actions.name: 四点跪位后坐髋屈活动
actions.phase_zh: 四点跪位温和后坐，手膝持续支撑，臀部尚未触及足跟。
actions.pose: True side view, facing image right. On a neutral-gray non-slip cushioned exercise mat, demonstrate quadruped hip rock-back at a SMALL comfortable backward shift: both palms flat on mat in front, both knees still in contact on mat, hips shifted modestly backward toward heels with hip flexion, buttocks clearly above and forward of heels, not sitting completely down on feet. Arms reach diagonally forward with elbows nearly straight, hands do not slide off mat. Spine remains naturally aligned, back not rounded deeply or hollowed. Lower legs and white-socked feet rest on mat behind knees. Neck follows trunk and gaze toward mat. Show full profile including all four support points; use a slight 10-degree oblique angle if needed to distinguish the far palm and knee. No traction bands or assistance.

actions.name: 四点跪位猫式与舒适伸展
actions.phase_zh: 四点跪位猫式轻圆背阶段，头顺势轻低，手在肩下、膝在髋下。
actions.pose: Right-facing true side view of gentle CAT phase on neutral-gray cushioned non-slip mat. Both palms planted approximately under shoulders with arms straight, both knees planted approximately under hips hip-width apart, shins and white-socked feet resting behind. Gently round the upper and mid back into a modest smooth convex curve while pelvis makes a small natural posterior tilt. Head lowers gently in line with curve, gaze toward mat; no extreme chin compression. Buttocks remain above knees, not rocked back onto heels. No exaggerated high arch, no sagging abdomen, no hyperextended neck. Show all limbs and their mat contact points, with a slight oblique separation of far limbs.

actions.name: 死虫式：脚跟滑动到对侧伸展

Full body supine on a neutral-gray non-slip mat, head toward image right, feet toward image left, near-true lateral view slightly oblique so both legs are distinct. Head, shoulders, trunk and pelvis resting comfortably on mat, neck neutral. Both arms rest naturally by torso on mat with palms down. Far leg remains bent at about 80 degrees at knee with foot planted flat on mat. Near leg has slowly slid its heel farther away along mat, now almost straight but still softly bent about 20 degrees; its white-socked HEEL remains in contact with mat, not suspended. Pelvis remains level and comfortable neutral lower back, no visible exaggerated arch. Exactly two separate legs and two natural arms visible. No raised arms, no raised tabletop leg, no knee hugged to chest.

actions.name: 鸟狗式：单肢到对侧手脚

LEFT palm remains planted beneath left shoulder, RIGHT knee remains planted beneath right hip. RIGHT arm reaches forward toward image right at trunk height with relaxed open hand, elbow nearly straight. LEFT leg extends backward toward image left at trunk height, knee nearly straight, white-socked foot relaxed. Right hand and left leg form an elongated horizontal reach, neither lifted above back. The SUPPORTING LEFT hand and SUPPORTING RIGHT KNEE must both be visible; exactly two arms and two legs. Spine neutral, pelvis square facing mat, no lumbar arch or trunk rotation. Head follows spine and gaze down. All fingertips, supporting palm, knee and both feet fully inside frame.

Both knees clearly off mat at same low height, no padded block beneath knees. Head follows back, eyes on mat, abdomen natural. All four support points visible, entire body included.
